tools.name: dataset_columns
tools.description: The columns, which of them are numeric, the row count and the provenance banner of the Wen Receipts dataset. Call this first to learn the schema.

tools.name: dataset_search
tools.description: Rows of the Wen Receipts dataset whose cells contain the query (case-insensitive), up to 50.

tools.name: dataset_row
tools.description: The rows of the Wen Receipts dataset where a column equals a value exactly (case-insensitive).

tools.name: dataset_compare
tools.description: The rows of the Wen Receipts dataset whose column is any of the given values, in the order given — for "X vs Y" questions.

tools.name: dataset_stats
tools.description: count, min, max, mean, median and sum of a numeric column of the Wen Receipts dataset (grouping commas and currency are handled; non-numeric rows are excluded and counted).

tools.name: dataset_top
tools.description: The highest (or lowest) rows of the Wen Receipts dataset by a numeric column — "which is the most/least X".

tools.name: dataset_provenance
tools.description: The source, the date it was computed, the licence and the citation for the Wen Receipts dataset. Read this to attribute a figure correctly.

tools.name: entities_schema
tools.description: Which fields the Wen Receipts register register carries and on how many entities, the regions and services, the identifier schemes, and how to cite it. Call this first.

tools.name: entity_lookup
tools.description: The Wen Receipts register entry for a firm, by its register identifier (scheme + value, e.g. lei) or by the slug of its page. Exact match; returns the whole record with its page.

tools.name: entities_search
tools.description: Entities of Wen Receipts register whose name, commercial name, website, address or authority contains the query, optionally within a region (id or name) and a service (slug or name). Up to 50 rows.

tools.name: entities_in
tools.description: The Wen Receipts register entities in one region (a state or a jurisdiction, by id or name), optionally for one service, 50 a page.

tools.name: entities_export
tools.description: Every entity of Wen Receipts register, 200 a page, with provenance. Needs an access key (Authorization: Bearer); export pages are metered per key per day. Without a key the answer says how to get one.

tools.name: listing_describe
tools.description: What a listing on Wen Receipts is, what it costs, how it is paid, who publishes it, and every profile field it takes. Read this to the person first.

tools.name: listing_terms
tools.description: The clauses a listing is judged by, their version (send it back as termsVersion), and every profile field the directory takes.

tools.name: agent_session_start
tools.description: Give a Solana address; get the exact message to sign. A signature, not a transaction: no fee, nothing moves. Then call agent_session_verify with the base64 signature.

tools.name: agent_session_verify
tools.description: The address, the exact message from agent_session_start and its base64 Ed25519 signature. Returns a session token to pass as `session` to every later call (valid 30 days, revocable from the account page).

tools.name: claim_start
tools.description: Names the entry (scheme + value, e.g. lei); returns the proof domain the register lists and the token to place as a TXT record, a well-known file, or via a verified email there.

tools.name: claim_verify
tools.description: The server reads DNS, the well-known file and the verified email; verified claims are badges on the profile.

tools.name: claim_status
tools.description: Every claim of this account with its status and, while pending, the instructions.

tools.name: listing_draft
tools.description: Creates a listing draft on Wen Receipts. Send the fullest profile you can (listing_describe lists the fields); a scam-shaped or off-list field is refused by name. Returns the listing id and status awaiting_payment.

tools.name: listing_pay_card
tools.description: Returns a Stripe Checkout URL at the site's price. A human completes it in a browser; the site learns of payment from Stripe's verified event, never from the browser.

tools.name: listing_pay_stripe
tools.description: Send a Stripe payment method id (pm_...) the agent is entitled to use; the server charges the SITE's price off-session. Answers succeeded (the listing enters review) or requires_action (use listing_pay_card for a human); never charges an amount you name.

tools.name: listing_pay_usdc
tools.description: Returns the Solana Pay transfer request: recipient, exact amount, USDC mint and a unique reference. Pay it from the wallet (include the reference as a read-only key), then call listing_confirm_usdc.

tools.name: listing_confirm_usdc
tools.description: The SERVER finds the transfer by reference and reads the treasury's balance change; a short or wrong-token transfer is reported by name and not credited. On success the listing enters review.

tools.name: listing_status
tools.description: Every listing of this account with its status (awaiting_payment, pending_review, published, refused, withdrawn, expired).

tools.name: listing_withdraw
tools.description: Takes down a listing of this account.

tools.name: listings_published
tools.description: What firms have added on top of the register (published rows only), optionally for one register entry.

tools.name: placements_active
tools.description: The Sponsored slot's contents for a page (home | region | leaf); labelled as sponsored in the answer.

tools.name: claim_public
tools.description: Whether an entry has a verified claim, by which proof and when — never by whom.

tools.name: enquiry_describe
tools.description: Read first. States plainly what submit_enquiry does on Wen Receipts: it starts an enquiry with human providers who quote directly. Nothing is bought, ordered or paid; no quote is guaranteed; it is free. Also returns who receives the details, the consent wording, and how the person confirms.

tools.name: enquiry_fields
tools.description: Every field of the Wen Receipts enquiry: key, label, type, whether required, help text and the allowed options where there are any. Pass answers to submit_enquiry keyed by field key.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Submits an enquiry to Wen Receipts — NOT a purchase, NOT a guaranteed quote. Step 1: call with the answers (keyed by field key from enquiry_fields) and consent=true; it validates and returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token — show the person the summary and the consent line. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_session_start, submit_enquiry · Private data: entity_lookup, agent_session_verify, claim_start, claim_verify, listing_pay_usdc, listing_confirm_usdc, submit_enquiry · Public sink: listing_terms, claim_start, claim_verify, listing_draft, listing_pay_stripe, submit_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_session_start, submit_enquiry · Private data: entity_lookup, agent_session_verify, claim_start, claim_verify, listing_pay_usdc, listing_confirm_usdc, submit_enquiry · Public sink: listing_terms, claim_start, claim_verify, listing_draft, listing_pay_stripe, submit_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
